svg.title: Hand-cranked site winch — Handknúin dráttarvinda
svg.desc: A horizontal rope drum sits between two frame plates with an outboard crank handle and a free cable end.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-hand-winch","label_en":"Hand-cranked site winch","label_is":"Handknúin dráttarvinda","section":"02","category_en":"Lifting, access and site logistics","category_is":"Lyftingar, aðgengi og flutningar á verkstað","batch":1,"tags":["rigging","winch"],"description":"A horizontal rope drum sits between two frame plates with an outboard crank handle and a free cable end.","design_note":"Horizontal winding drum, side crank and anchored frame identify a hand winch rather than a hanging hoist.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
